scripts-info.start: Start the TradeSource practice site at http://localhost:4321 (needed for codegen; tests start it automatically)
scripts-info.test: Run all Playwright tests headlessly (no browser window) - fastest, use for CI and quick checks
scripts-info.test:head: Run all tests with a visible browser window so you can watch them execute
scripts-info.test:ui: Open Playwright's interactive UI mode to pick, run, debug and time-travel through tests
scripts-info.codegen: Open the Playwright recorder against http://localhost:4321 to generate test code from your clicks
